# Demo recording script

A 1–2 minute screen recording of the bot for the README (GIF) and for the application (video link). Only synthetic documents from the test set are used.

## 1. Prepare (5 min)

The working database may hold real documents, and the Q&A agent searches all of them. Record against an empty demo database instead.

**Demo files.** Copy them to `data/demo/` (git-ignored). The scan is generated by `python eval/make_scans.py --src eval/dataset_test`.

| File | Source | Expected result |
|---|---|---|
| `1_invoice_adventure.pdf` | `eval/dataset_test/pdf/019_invoice_en.pdf` | ✅ auto-accepted |
| `2_insurance_scan.jpg` | heavy scan of `001_insurance_en.pdf`, as a photo | ⚠️ review, confidence ~0.5 |
| `3_contract_fabrikam.pdf` | `eval/dataset_test/pdf/014_contract_en.pdf` | ✅ auto-accepted |

**Switch the API to an empty database** (PowerShell, repo root):

```powershell
docker compose exec -T db createdb -U docflow docflow_demo
$env:DOCFLOW_DB = 'docflow_demo'; docker compose up -d api
```

**Check the tunnel.** The bot must be reachable: `python n8n/set_webhook.py --info` should show no recent error. If the tunnel was restarted, register the new URL with `python n8n/set_webhook.py`.

**Recording setup:**
- Use Telegram Desktop with only the bot chat visible: close other chats, hide the chat list, set the window to about 900×700.
- Record with [ScreenToGif](https://www.screentogif.com/) (GIF, 10–15 fps) or the Windows Game Bar (`Win+Alt+R`, MP4).

## 2. Scenario (~90 s)

| Time | Action | What the viewer sees |
|---|---|---|
| 0–15 s | Send `1_invoice_adventure.pdf` | ✅ with the fields: Adventure Works Ltd, 493.32 GBP, due 2026-07-23 |
| 15–35 s | Send `2_insurance_scan.jpg` as a **photo** | ⚠️ "low confidence 0.5 < 0.6" with the extracted fields and the buttons ✅ ✏️ 🗑 |
| 35–45 s | Check the fields against the photo and press **✅** (or **✏️** and reply with a fix such as `issue_date=2026-07-26`) | The decision is saved with your name; the buttons disappear |
| 45–55 s | Send `3_contract_fabrikam.pdf` | ✅ contract, valid until 2027-01-31 |
| 55–75 s | Type `How much do I owe Adventure Works, and by when?` | Answer with 493.32 GBP, 2026-07-23 and `#1` |
| 75–90 s | Type `When does the contract with Fabrikam expire?` | 2027-01-31, `#3` |
| 90–100 s | Run the reminders "as of" 2027-01-24 (command below) | ⏰ reminder: the contract expires in 7 days |

**Reminders command** (reads the key from `.env`, prints nothing secret):

```powershell
$k = ((Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^SERVICE_API_KEY=').Line -split '=', 2)[1] -replace '\s+#.*$', ''; Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri http://localhost:5678/webhook/reminders/run -Headers @{ 'X-API-Key' = $k.Trim() } -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"today": "2027-01-24"}'
```

**Optional extra shots:**
- the n8n canvas at http://localhost:5678 (5 s, to show the workflow);
- `http://localhost:8000/stats`, showing the cost of the session.

## 3. After recording

**Switch the API back to the working database:**

```powershell
Remove-Item Env:DOCFLOW_DB; docker compose up -d api
```

**Optionally drop the demo database:**

```powershell
docker compose exec -T db dropdb -U docflow docflow_demo
```

**Publishing the recording:**
- **GIF for the README:** under 10 MB. Trim to the 30–45 s with the best moments (invoice ✅, scan ⚠️ + button, one question). Save it as `docs/img/demo.gif` and uncomment the demo line at the top of the README.
- **Full video:** upload it as an unlisted YouTube video or a Loom, and link it in the README and in the application.
- **Before publishing,** check every frame for anything personal: your Telegram name and avatar, other chats, notifications.

Cost of one run: ~$0.04 for the three extractions plus <$0.01 for the questions.
